# Every value form, a stopgap reporter, every visibility, build and
# projection, and every kind of path segment and path mark.
inspection 7
  unit pages "pages"
  integer small -5 @width unit pages
  integer index 0 9
  text label 8 utf8
  text raw 4
  atoms shade light dark
  list labels label 3
  tuple pair index raw
  list pairs pair 2
  stopgap gap kernel "gap label" "what the gap sees"

  kind thing
    attr count small reporters kernel,gap visible owner build all projections shell,host
    attr secret raw reporters service visible system_shell build development projections none
    attr name label reporters runtime visible any build all projections proc
    attr shade shade reporters kernel visible all build all projections web
    attr pairs pairs reporters kernel visible any build all projections shell
    attr flag boolean reporters kernel visible any build all projections shell
    attr owner proc_id reporters kernel visible any build all projections shell
    attr rights rights reporters kernel visible any build all projections shell
    attr object object_type reporters kernel visible any build all projections shell
    attr status status reporters kernel visible any build all projections shell
    attr page @page reporters kernel visible any build all projections shell
    attr colour @colour reporters kernel visible any build all projections shell
    attr mode @mode reporters kernel visible any build all projections shell
    attr labels labels reporters runtime visible any build development projections shell

  path listing
  path listing things
    visible all
  path thing things *index
  path listing things *index secret
    visible system_shell
  path listing named
  path thing named *label
  path listing owners
  path thing owners *proc_id
  path listing log
    entries label 100
    append_only
